summary: First-pass full-stack testing of Grameen Udyog AI Advisory after CRA->Vite migration and large feature addition. Backend (Node/Express) 17/17 pytest cases pass covering health, auth (register/login/me/invalid), calculator precision (monthly+quarterly, tail balance clears, principal sums to approved_loan, 400 on <5000 & negative), feasibility (full response shape: 5-item cost_breakdown, recommendation quartet, schemes with required_documents, government_support, vendors with price+contact+distance, supply_chain stages), viability variance across 4 category/margin combos (produced varied scores, NOT all >=80), reports CRUD (create->list->get->delete->404), community shops (points 10+5+3=18 on create with photo+contact, cannot upvote own -> 400, second user upvote awards +2 to owner, leaderboard sorted). Frontend E2E via Playwright on the public preview URL: landing loads, /register creates user and redirects to /advisory, the 4-step wizard completes (state=Maharashtra->Nashik->Sinnar->Musalgaon, category=Retail Kirana Store, preset ₹1,00,000, quarterly toggle, generate), ReportView renders with section-recommendation, section-revenue, section-schemes, section-vendors, section-supply-chain, Community add-shop flow awards +13 points (badge updates 0->13), success toast shows, shop appears in the directory. No critical bugs found.

issues: Toast 'Account created' overlaps NavBar user-menu on right side at 1920px (see screenshot). Purely cosmetic; toast disappears in ~3s.

critical_code_review_comments: server.js is ~840 lines with routes+business logic mixed; consider splitting into routes/ and services/ for maintainability (non-blocking).
JWT_SECRET has a hardcoded fallback in server.js — acceptable for MVP but production should force env-only.
callGeminiAI has no logging when the response cannot be parsed; add a console.warn to aid future debugging.

/api/shops/:id/upvote toggles (double-post removes). This is fine but not obvious — a small comment would help. Also negative points can occur if a user un-upvotes after the owner's points were spent elsewhere (no floor at 0).
test_credentials: Random TEST_* emails registered per run via /api/auth/register (password test1234). Two users created for upvote flow.
seed_data_creation: No seed data required. Tests create their own TEST_-prefixed users, reports and shops each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend runs under supervisor program 'node-backend' on port 8001 (python 'backend' program is intentionally STOPPED). Frontend Vite runs on 3000. All backend routes are /api/*. Auth via Authorization: Bearer <token>, errors in `detail`. Categories = 20, locations nested 4-level. Viability score is deterministic per (village,category,district) seed with +/-4 jitter and 28..96 clamp. Points: SHOP_DETAILS=10, SHOP_PHOTO=5 (if data:image), SHOP_CONTACT=3, UPVOTE_RECEIVED=2. pytest command: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`.
